caps: HIT 8% vs raid bosses (Forever removed hit suppression, so the cap dropped from 9% to 8%); about 5% vs level-equal mobs. Past the cap hit is worth ~0, so drop HIT to about AGI value per point.
Weapon skill: ~5 skill is about 3% hit vs bosses (Warcraft Tavern); no key for it in GearGuide.
BEASTMASTERY.notes: AGI = 2 RAP + 1 melee AP, 53 AGI = 1% crit at 60 (same as classic). AP is counted at RAP value plus a little extra because it covers melee too. Forever: pets inherit 100% of the hunter's crit and 10% of the higher AP, and Intimidation gives the pet 100% crit, so CRIT is weighted close to HIT. Bestial Discipline adds mana regen. Sources disagree on INT/SPI/STA order (Mobalytics: INT > STA > STR > SPI; wow.gg beta: SPI > INT > STA). Weapon DPS is first in every source, so it gets the top weight even though it is only ~25 RAP per point in theory. Ranks follow per-point weights, so percent stats come before AGI. Forever unifies hit and crit across melee, ranged and spells (rated at 10 rating per 1% hit and 14 per 1% crit at 60, from beta files), so SHIT=HIT and SCRIT=CRIT. HASTE (per 1%) affects melee, ranged and casting speed. It is rare on gear, has no breakpoints and does not speed up DoTs; it is weighted below CRIT, and the rating needed per 1% is unannounced. RDPS (ranged weapon DPS) is the main weapon stat. DPS (melee weapon) gets only 0.5 because the melee weapon is mostly a stat stick (occasional Raptor Strike / Wing Clip).

SURVIVAL.notes: In Forever, Survival is a melee spec (2H weapon or two one-handers). Melee AP comes from AGI (1:1) and STR (1:1), and 53 AGI = 1% crit, so most of AGI's value is crit. Predator's Edge makes melee crits and off-hand attacks stronger, so CRIT is high. Careful Aim at 3/5 converts 60% of INT into AP. DPS = melee weapon DPS (main weapon). RDPS = 1.5 because the ranged weapon is a secondary stat slot. Icy Veins lists weapon dmg and AGI as the main stats, with an 8% soft cap. wow.gg (2026-11-04): melee weapon dmg > hit > crit > agi > AP. wow.gg beta (older) ranked SPI and INT above STA, HIT and CRIT. Forever unifies hit and crit across melee, ranged and spells (rated at 10 rating per 1% hit and 14 per 1% crit at 60, from beta files), so SHIT=HIT and SCRIT=CRIT. HASTE (per 1%) affects melee, ranged and casting speed. It is rare on gear, has no breakpoints and does not speed up DoTs; it is weighted below CRIT, and the rating needed per 1% is unannounced. EXPERTISE is not ranked by any hunter guide, so it is left out; if a melee-Survival source ranks it later, roughly HIT value up to about 6.5% from behind is a reasonable start.
